'''The Learning''' was the curriculum of the [[Learning Circle]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kegan/Legends|Kegan]]. The teaching course was developed by [[Benevolent Guide]]s [[V-Tan]] and [[O-Vieve]] in roughly [[59 BBY/Legends|59 BBY]]. It emphasized that happiness came from contributing to the [[General Good]] rather than seeking other personal gratifications. Additionally, students were taught misleading "facts" about planets, systems, and people outside of the [[Kegan system/Legends|Kegan system]], to encourage isolation of the planet from the outside [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]. The curriculum covered students from young children aged four up to sixteen years old; however, exceptions were made for people like [[V-Davi]], who started his education at the age of two when his parents died due to the [[Toli-X]] outbreak. At the age of twelve, students went before a committee that decided the career path for their continued education and future occupation.
